results.optimization: Change K-quant sub-group size from SIMD32 to SIMD16 native on Intel Xe2
results.notes: Changed K-quant kernels (Q2_K through Q6_K) from forced SIMD32 (QK_WARP_SIZE=32) to native SIMD16. Added GGML_SYCL_DMMV_K_SUBGRP_SIZE constant defaulting to WARP_SIZE (16 on Intel Xe2). Updated reqd_sub_group_size attributes, block_dims, and reduction masks. Expected 15-40% occupancy improvement from native SIMD16. 726/726 MUL_MAT tests pass.

results.optimization: Increase work-group size from 1 to 256 for quantized copy, 32 to 256 for scalar copy
results.notes: Increased work-group size from 1 to 256 for all 11 quantized copy kernels (cpy_q_f32, cpy_f32_q variants). Also increased SYCL_CPY_BLOCK_SIZE from 32 to 256 for scalar copy kernels. This gives 256x more parallelism for quantized and 8x for scalar. 131/131 unit tests passed. Benchmark shows 37-39 GB/s for q4_0 quantized copy and 132-177 GB/s for f32/f16 scalar copy.

results.optimization: Fix tile size mismatch - use RDNA2 values instead of AMPERE
results.notes: Fixed bug where kernel hardcoded AMPERE values but dispatch selected based on compute_capability. For q5_0/q5_1/q8_0/q6_K this caused swapped mmq_x/mmq_y (128x64 vs 64x128). Now uses RDNA2 values as default for Intel Xe2. 726/726 tests passed.

XMX/joint_matrix implementation blocked by Intel oneAPI 2025.1 API change - experimental::matrix moved and unavailable. XMX infrastructure present in code but disabled. Build succeeds, 726/726 tests pass.
